paper: Physics-Driven Spatiotemporal Modeling for AI-Generated Video Detection (NSG-VD, Zhang, Lian, Yang, Li, Pang, Liu, Han, Li, Tan, NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight, arXiv 2510.08073)
training_set_in_paper: Table 1 of the paper (the NSG-VD MMD-MP row): the deep kernel trained on Kinetics-400 + Pika. The key serves the official checkpoint standard-Pika-mp.pth (no SynthScope-trained model; the official train_dMMD.py is not wrapped). The statistic is the deep-kernel MMD between a video's normalized spatiotemporal gradient features (guided-diffusion 256x256) and 100 MSR-VTT val reference videos; a video is generated iff it is > 1. The paper's subsets (~120 per generator) are unspecified, so the paper tables are NOT reproduced; the authors' released results CSV (500 per generator, Sora 51 + 56) is, with the official code on our data and with SynthScope. Metrics are the official ones: pooled accuracy (not balanced), recall / precision / F1 on the fake class, AUROC of the raw statistic. ffmpeg 4.2 is required (the build changes the frames). Exact parity with the official code at its own batching; the served path (1 video per diffusion pass and MMD batch) differs from the official batching (3 per pass, MMD batches of 24) by up to 0.27 per video.

benchmarks.name: GenVideo-Val, released-CSV protocol (500 per generator; Sora 51 + 56) vs the released CSV (not the paper)
benchmarks.metric: pooled accuracy and AUROC of the MMD statistic (fake iff statistic > 1), mean over the 10 generators; 500 MSR-VTT test reals (from index 200 of the split) + the first 500 test fakes per generator, Sora 56 reals + 51 fakes

paper_number.note: NOT the paper: the 10-generator averages of the authors' released results CSV assets/nsg-vd-test_results/standard-Pika-mmd-mp.csv (the released checkpoint on the released protocol).

our_number.note: 'Paper' column = the released CSV, not the paper. Reproduces the released CSV (500/generator, Sora 51+56), not the paper's tables. Avg accuracy 89.15 SynthScope, 89.42 official code, CSV 89.34. Sora AUROC 0.32 below the CSV, unexplained. Needs ffmpeg 4.2.

benchmarks.gap_cause: Per generator, accuracy / recall / F1 / precision are within 0.43 of the CSV for both paths. Unexplained: Sora AUROC is below the CSV for every checkpoint (this key: official code 96.53, SynthScope 96.67, CSV 96.99). The served path scores one video per diffusion pass (official: 3) and per MMD batch (official: 24), which flips about 30 of 9,107 verdicts (Avg accuracy differs by up to 0.27); on 75 videos the MMD batch alone reproduces that gap for the mp keys, not measured on the 9,107.
benchmarks.dataset_source: GenVideo-Val (ModelScope cccnju/Gen-Video), reals = MSR-VTT; result file repro/nsg_vd_benchmark_genvideo_val.json (checkpoints.standard-Pika-mp.L500), repro/bench_results/nsg_vd_pika_genvideo_split500.json

benchmarks.name: GenVideo-Val, paper Table 1 (120 per generator; L120, Sora 56 + 51) vs the released checkpoints
benchmarks.metric: pooled accuracy and AUROC (fake iff statistic > 1), mean over the 10 generators; L120 = the paper protocol (test_load_len 120, ffmpeg 4.2.2; authors confirmed 2026-11-13), Sora 56 reals + 51 fakes (the paper 56 + 56)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 1 (trained on Kinetics-400 + Pika), NSG-VD (Ours) row, Avg. column; 120 + 120 per generator, Sora 56 + 56 (authors, 2026-11-13).

our_number.note: NOT reproduced: recall is +8.65 above the paper (Sora: 51 fakes here, 56 there; authors' protocol, 2026-11-13). Official code vs paper, Avg: recall 96.67 vs 88.02, acc 89.71 vs 91.46, F1 90.31 vs 90.87, AUROC 96.88 vs 96.14. The released checkpoint/runs differ from the paper's; the CSV differs too (recall 95.86).

benchmarks.gap_cause: Paper protocol (authors, 2026-11-13): 120 + 120 per generator (Sora 56 + 56), ffmpeg 4.2.2; L120 is that run (Sora: 51 fakes here). Recall is +8.65 above Table 1 (acc -1.75, F1 -0.56, AUROC +0.73). The released checkpoint/runs differ from the paper's; the CSV differs by up to 7.84 (recall). Not reproduced.
